strain: To exclude peculiarities of a specific yeast genotype, we carried out purifications from three S. cerevisiae strains (YER165W with PAB1-GFP, JD1370, and YAG1021), grown in either rich (YPDA) or in synthetic defined (SD) medium (STAR Methods).
